name: Alonso Duel
description: Card battle with a shared deck and five cards always on the table. Each round both pick a card for the other to answer. Reach 100 points before Alonso. Combos, perfect blocks, shield, and crits.
author: Arborito Official

descriptions.en: Card battle with a shared deck and five cards always on the table. Each round both pick a card for the other to answer. Reach 100 points before Alonso. Combos, perfect blocks, shield, and crits.
descriptions.es: Batalla de cartas con un mazo común y 5 cartas siempre en la mesa. Cada ronda los dos eligen una carta para que el otro la responda. Llega a 100 puntos antes que Alonso. Combos, bloqueos perfectos, escudo y críticos.

name: Classroom Simulator
description: RPG classroom simulator. Judge classmates and answer the teacher. Static mode uses the author’s Quiz V2 questionnaires; dynamic mode adds optional local AI.
author: Community

descriptions.en: RPG classroom simulator. Judge classmates and answer the teacher. Static mode uses the author’s Quiz V2 questionnaires; dynamic mode adds optional local AI.
descriptions.es: Simulador de aula RPG. Juzga a tus compañeros y responde al profesor. Modo estático: cuestionarios Quiz V2 del autor; modo dinámico: IA local opcional.

name: First Job: Corp Sim
description: RPG job simulator. Take phone calls, go to the right floors, and manage stress by buying food in the cafeteria.
author: Arborito Official

descriptions.en: RPG job simulator. Take phone calls, go to the right floors, and manage stress by buying food in the cafeteria.
descriptions.es: Simulador de trabajo RPG. Recibe llamadas al móvil, sube a los pisos indicados y gestiona tu estrés comprando comida en la cafetería.

name: Hacky Terminal
description: Retro shell for lesson missions. Static mode replays course commands and quizzes; dynamic AI mode adds an interactive tutor.
author: Arborito Official

descriptions.en: Retro shell for lesson missions. Static mode replays course commands and quizzes; dynamic AI mode adds an interactive tutor.
descriptions.es: Terminal retro para misiones de lección. Modo estático: comandos y cuestionarios del curso; modo dinámico: tutor interactivo con IA.

name: Memory Garden: Overgrowth
description: Two modes: Pairs matches terms on a fast grid; Review shows a question-mark card — tap to flip, see the answer, then mark Good or Review so SRS schedules the next one.
author: Arborito Official

descriptions.en: Two modes: Pairs matches terms on a fast grid; Review shows a question-mark card — tap to flip, see the answer, then mark Good or Review so SRS schedules the next one.
descriptions.es: Dos modos: Pares empareja términos en una rejilla rápida; Repaso muestra una tarjeta con signo de pregunta: la tocas, gira, ves la respuesta y marcas Bien o Repasar para que el SRS programe la próxima.

name: Starship Learner
description: Epic space odyssey: explore galaxies, fight the Void Chorus, recover knowledge fragments, and follow a chapter story.
author: Arborito Official

descriptions.en: Epic space odyssey: explore galaxies, fight the Void Chorus, recover knowledge fragments, and follow a chapter story.
descriptions.es: Odisea espacial épica: explora galaxias, combate al Coro del Vacío, recupera fragmentos de conocimiento y vive una historia por capítulos.

name: Wrong Fruit
description: Guide a hungry garden worm through short garden sessions. Eat fruits with the right answers; dodge hedges, rocks, and hostile garden gnomes.
author: Arborito Official

descriptions.en: Guide a hungry garden worm through short garden sessions. Eat fruits with the right answers; dodge hedges, rocks, and hostile garden gnomes.
descriptions.es: Guía un gusano del jardín por sesiones cortas. Come las frutas con las respuestas correctas; esquiva setos, rocas y gnomos hostiles.
